minutes.headline: Planning Board approved the Northfield Road common driveway permit despite a member's subdivision-precedent concerns.
minutes.summary: The board reopened and closed a public hearing on a 5-lot common driveway and storm water permit at Northfield Road, approving both despite one member's concern that it functions as an unpermitted subdivision and sets a policy precedent; it also denied a requested paving-material waiver as not authorized by bylaw. The board also endorsed an ANR plan, recommended waiving the town's first right of refusal on an open space parcel, reviewed and gave detailed feedback on the draft MBTA Communities zoning bylaw (public hearing moved to October 27th), and discussed extensive concerns about the Master Plan Steering Committee's draft recommendations being too vague and unactionable.

what_happened.line: Planning Board approved both permits for a 5-lot common driveway at 1083 Northfield Road, over one member's objection that it functions as an unpermitted subdivision.
The board denied the applicant's request to waive the bylaw's paving-material requirement and will consider a warrant article to remove that requirement instead.
The public hearing on the draft MBTA Communities zoning bylaw amendment was pushed from September 22 to October 27, with warrant article language due October 2.
The board recommended the Select Board waive the town's first right of refusal on the West Townsend Road open space parcel and endorsed an ANR plan at 830 Massachusetts Avenue.
Members raised extensive concerns that the Master Plan Steering Committee's draft recommendations are too vague to act on.

why_it_matters: The Northfield Road approval sets a precedent for using the common-driveway process to divide land the way a subdivision would, which affects how future multi-lot developments in town can proceed.
The MBTA Communities zoning bylaw determines how the town complies with the state's multi-family housing law, and residents will get a vote on it at Town Meeting after the October 27 hearing.
The warrant article on common-driveway paving requirements and the West Townsend Road open space decision both go before Town Meeting and the Select Board respectively.
watch_next: Public hearing on the MBTA Communities zoning bylaw, October 27
